# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All 111 workspace tests pass: 8 concentration_helpers, 5 save_load, 8 cycling (including new decomposer_do_half_saturation_is_tunable), 3 startup_overrides (including new zero-volume substrate override regression), 17 end_to_end, 6 events, 8 water_change_mass_balance, 7 materialization, and others
- cargo fmt --all --check passes with no diffs
- cargo clippy --all-targets passes with only pre-existing derivable_impls warning in StartupOverrides (unrelated to this changeset)
- Amendment fr-2-7ec97029 verified: shrimp_feeding, update_condition, update_molt_stress, emit_molt_stress_warning signatures updated to accept only `state: &mut TankState`; all four call sites in step_daily_shrimp updated; zero-volume guard (volume_l <= f64::EPSILON) preserved at entry point
- Amendment fr-2-b9d261ac verified: decomposer_k_do_mg field added to ProcessParams (process.rs:40) with default 2.0; ProcessParamsPreset includes field with serde default function returning 2.0; nitrogen_cycle.rs:83 now reads `pp.decomposer_k_do_mg.max(0.01)` instead of hardcoded 2.0; plumbed through process_preset_to_params() in tank_scenarios; regression test creates two states with K_DO=0.1 vs 10.0 and asserts differential TAN production and DOC consumption
- Amendment fr-2-7a74aad7 verified: apply_startup_overrides now resolves effective_source_profile when either source_water_profile_id or substrate_preset is present; rebuilds WaterState via from_source_profile_for_volume_l() instead of rescaling possibly-zeroed totals; regression test uses medium_planted with fill_ratio=0.1 and InertSand substrate, verifies 0.36L water volume has non-zero nitrate (1.8 mg_n), alkalinity (0.45 meq), and calcium (9.0 mg) totals
- All 15 canonical concentration helpers remain intact on WaterState and TankState (tan_mg_n_per_l, nitrite_mg_n_per_l, nitrate_mg_n_per_l, don_mg_n_per_l, doc_mg_c_per_l, dic_mg_c_per_l, do_mg_per_l, phosphate_mg_p_per_l, alkalinity_meq_per_l, calcium_mg_per_l, magnesium_mg_per_l, gh_d, kh_d, tds_mg_per_l, conductivity_us_cm)
- Property test (proptest, 256 cases) still verifies all helper outputs >= 0.0 for random geometry and chemistry inputs
- rescale_totals_for_volume removed from startup override path; only remaining usage is in seeded_example() test fixture where old_volume is always positive

## Findings and Gaps

- Pre-existing clippy::derivable_impls warning in tank_scenarios::StartupOverrides (lib.rs:191) remains — carried forward from prior rounds, unrelated to CR3 changes
- Decomposer DOC and DO half-saturation parameters remain expressed in total-mass units (decomposer_k_doc_mg, decomposer_k_do_mg); the broader concentration-based normalization is correctly deferred to downstream beads tanksim-6e5.2.3/2.4/2.5
- Startup override rebuild unconditionally replaces WaterState from source profile when substrate changes — this is correct for initial materialization but would need an alternate mode if future flows need to preserve intentionally aged chemistry across substrate swaps (not a current concern)

## Follow-up and Amendments

- Pre-existing clippy derivable_impls warning in tank_scenarios::StartupOverrides should be fixed in a housekeeping pass
